experiment: exact-parameter CP factorized multi-view SAE v1

external_mechanism_evidence.paper: fmxcoders: Factorized Masked Crosscoders for Cross-Layer Feature Discovery
external_mechanism_evidence.used_result: The paper's unmasked CP factorization improves average single-latent probing F1 over per-layer SAE baselines on GPT2, Pythia, and Gemma, including Bias in Bios, AG News, EuroParl, Amazon Sentiment and Amazon category tasks.
external_mechanism_evidence.local_adaptation: Replace the layer mode with four interleaved token views from the same L22 text so training and evaluation retain the same L22 activation source as ordinary SAE baselines.

hypothesis: A CP-factorized encoder/decoder shared across disjoint views of one text will form sample-stable semantic coordinates that a standard mean-pooled SAE and a cross-sample view control cannot recover.

training.view_definition: token position modulo 4 within each real sample
training.rank_selection: largest integer CP rank that fits below the 402721792-parameter ReLU budget before assigning every remaining parameter to the feature-gain module

variants.frozen_relu: Unchanged token-mean ReLU checkpoint, evaluated only.
variants.mean_pooled_control: Exact-parameter ordinary ReLU SAE; encode the mean of four L22 views and reconstruct all views with one shared decoder.
variants.wrong_alignment: Exact-parameter CP model trained on four independently shifted sample views; each view marginal is unchanged and all fixed pairs are forbidden.
variants.candidate: Exact-parameter CP model trained on four true views from the same L22 text sample.
